title: Kissed with Robata Smoke American Bok Choi Skewers
description: Delicious, malty, and crispy American bok choi skewers kissed with the smoky flavor of robata-grill, perfect for adventurous vegetarians.

ingredients.name: Cornstarch
ingredients.notes: Mixed with water to make a slurry

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together malt vinegar, soy sauce, honey, ginger paste, and garlic to make the glaze.
Thread bok choi florets onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the bok choi skewers with vegetable oil and season with salt.
Preheat the robata-grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the bok choi skewers for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until slightly charred.
In a small saucepan, heat the glaze over medium heat until slightly thickened.
Brush the glaze over the grilled bok choi skewers.
Sprinkle with chopped green onions and cilantro.
To make the slurry, mix cornstarch with water in a small bowl until smooth.
Pour the slurry over the grilled bok choi skewers and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
